descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S07 「app 里的 UAT 第 2 步：没有时间的出院出现点一下的 '<= 30 / > 30 min' 提示，选择在重新加载后还在；口述里说了时间的出院，记录里保留时间，按时间定代码，不弹提示（两个模式）」 UAT step 2 in the app: a discharge with no time gets the one-tap '<= 30 / > 30 min' prompt and the choice survives a reload; a discharge whose dictation states the time keeps the time in the note and is coded from it wi …

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Discharge (Hospital 99238 / 99239, SNF 99315 / 99316): if the time is in the note, the code is set from it (<= 30 min -> 99238 / 99315, > 30 min -> 99239 / 99316); …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 5；TFA-92596 What (SNF discharge new family)） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21 step 6；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed.（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Fixture Hospital patient and resident; the discharge template chosen by hand; each leg its own case with a fresh session

When h-no-time / n-no-time: Generate a Discharge summary / SNF discharge with no time -> Post-Round -> tap '> 30 min' (Hospital) or '<= 30 min' (Nursing Home) -> reload. h-time / h-over30 / n-time: Generate with the time in the dictation ('Total discharge time 40 minutes.' / 'Over 30 minutes spent on discharge.' / 'Total d …

Then No time: before the tap no discharge code is shown, only the prompt; after the tap 99239 / 99315, still there after reload. Time dictated: the note contains the time, the card shows 99239 / 99316 with no prompt and no MDM level

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint: prompt checkpoints mustContainAny both options and mustNotContain any discharge code, any other family and the no-result texts; after the tap mustContain the chosen code and not the other, billingCard exactlyOneCode + noReasoning + noLevelWords; after reload the same. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
